# Repo rules

- API: Go in apps/api. Handlers take app.Ctx; register them in a package-level Register(r *http.Router).
- Web: React + vitest in apps/web. Call the API only through src/api/client.ts.
- Shared types live in packages/contract and are re-exported from its index.ts.
- `make lint` and `make test` must pass before a change is done.

test-web:
	pnpm --filter web test

test: test-api test-web
files.docs/adr/0007-share-tokens.md:
# 7. Share tokens are opaque random strings

Status: accepted

## Decision
A share token is 32 bytes from crypto/rand, hex-encoded (64 characters). It carries no data and is not a JWT. Tokens are stored in store.KV under the namespace `share_links`, mapping token -> schedule id. Links do not expire in the first version; revocation comes later.

## Why
Opaque tokens can be revoked by deleting one KV entry, and leak nothing if logged.
import { render, screen } from '@testing-library/react'
import { MemoryRouter, Route, Routes } from 'react-router-dom'
import { vi } from 'vitest'
import * as client from '../api/client'
import { SessionContext } from '../session'
import { SchedulePage } from './SchedulePage'

test('renders the schedule title', async () => {
  vi.spyOn(client, 'apiGet').mockResolvedValue({ id: 's1', ownerId: 'u1', title: 'Week', entries: [] })
  render(
    <SessionContext.Provider value={{ userId: 'u1' }}>
      <MemoryRouter initialEntries={['/schedules/s1']}>
        <Routes><Route path="/schedules/:id" element={<SchedulePage />} /></Routes>
      </MemoryRouter>
    </SessionContext.Provider>,
  )
  expect(await screen.findByText('Week')).toBeTruthy()
})

about: same fixture and plan as plan-sound, except no task owns routes.go or checks that share.Register is wired: the endpoints would exist but be unreachable (the half-wired failure the reviewer catches late)

plan.goal: Schedule owners can share a schedule through a public, read-only link.
plan.definition_of_done: As a schedule owner I click Share, get a link, and anyone who opens it, signed in or not, sees the schedule read-only. Nobody else can create links for my schedules.
acceptance: POST /schedules/:id/share by the owner returns 201 with a ShareLink whose token is 64 hex characters and whose url is WEB_ORIGIN/share/<token> (api test)
POST /schedules/:id/share returns 401 for an anonymous caller, 403 for a signed-in non-owner and 404 for an unknown schedule, and creates no link in each case (api tests)
GET /share/:token with no credentials returns 200 and schedules.PublicView of the schedule (no owner id); an unknown token returns 404 (api tests)
Only GET is routed for /share/:token: POST to it returns 405 (api test through the real router)
On SchedulePage the owner sees a Share button that calls POST /schedules/:id/share and copies the returned url; anyone else sees no button; an API failure shows an error message (web tests)
The web route /share/:token fetches GET /share/:token and renders the schedule read-only, and shows 'This link doesn't exist' on 404 (web tests)
decisions: Tokens are opaque: 32 bytes from crypto/rand, hex-encoded; not JWTs (docs/adr/0007-share-tokens.md)
Links are stored in store.KV, namespace share_links, token -> schedule id; no migration is needed
Links don't expire in this job
The API builds ShareLink.url as config.WebOrigin + '/share/' + token
